steps.name: Déjà Vu
steps.objective: Turn in the quest to [Dayna] in 「Guild Union City Esnil」.

steps.name: An Incident That Calls for a Witch
steps.objective:
1. In 「Guild Union City Esnil」, listen to [Kaina]'s story in front of [Dayna], then [Chloris]'s story in front of [Jelic].
2. Once both conversations are over, turn in the quest to [Notos] in 「Nereis Gatewayway」.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: There's something I'd like to tell you.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: About the new witch who will soon appear...

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Narsha, let me apologize first. This is important, so I must borrow the adventurer for a while.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Yes, Your Majesty. I understand. I'll take my leave, then.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Narsha, let's have that meal later.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Yes, adventurer.
(At Kaina's wave, Narsha and the knights standing some distance away withdraw.)

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Now we can talk. A little sudden, isn't it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Your Majesty has always been sudden, as far as I know. As though it were all arranged, and you wanted me to take care of something...

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Pardon?

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: You could have thought much worse of me. I'm glad that's all it is.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: That isn't funny. Don't make jokes like that.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: I only said it because I'm relieved.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Is her personality a little unusual...?)

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Sister. Tell us who this witch is and where she'll appear. No vague hints. Everything.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: You know I can't know everything. I only learn little things a little sooner than other people.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Little things?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Has even one of your prophecies ever been a little thing? Look at what's happened recently. The problem is that you think of it that way. Those events threatened to shake the whole world!

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Don't take something that could have killed so many people lightly.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: That isn't what I meant by little things, Dayna.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: I'm grateful you've saved lives, but I need to know. What are you hiding? How do you learn these things? Do you receive divine revelations? What is it?

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Dayna, I can't tell you that.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: It's always like this. You always hide things and run away.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I knew they didn't get along, but...)

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: I'm a fool for expecting anything from you.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Dayna, I'm going to explain now. May I?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Do what you want...

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: It concerns the witch who will soon appear, and the council. %s... Which would you like to hear about first?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: So there was more than one thing. Ugh...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Which should I hear about first?)

choices.text: 1. The witch who will soon appear.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: As someone who works for Lady Iris, you will continue to encounter witches.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Whether intentionally or otherwise. Just as with the witches you met on Aie Island...

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: They...

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: They understand what it means to tamper with life...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is that what the witches are trying to do? Like what Weiss intended?

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: I cannot say that much. Every witch has a different goal.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Circe said that as a witch, she naturally had to harm other witches...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Hilda was busy just trying to escape...)

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: That's far too vague...

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: %s, wait for the person who will soon come to see Dayna...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The familiar pattern of something being about to happen...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Where do Her Majesty's prophecies come from?)

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: The council is an institution the nobles formed early in the Empire's history to disperse the power concentrated in the emperor.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: For a long time, it has worked in the name of the Empire. But at some point, its voice grew louder than the imperial family's.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Sister, get to the point.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: The council plans to send mages and soldiers to find a witch. But they have almost no information about witches.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Is that why Aaron, the chairman, made a move?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Aaron...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah! The man I saw at the Nereis Gateway... He said he did some minor work for the council...

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Aaron Kandel Thienes. The current head of House Thienes, which has led the council since the Empire's earliest days.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: He rarely acts personally...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I met him briefly at the Nereis Gateway. He mentioned witch-related business and said we might keep running into each other.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: I see. For now, I've asked Argent to watch the movements of the council's troops and knight orders.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: The public could become unsettled, and we must prevent the council from taking overt action...

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: And?

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: We must avoid a clash between the council and the witches as far as possible.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Do you think that's possible now that the council has acted? Surely you don't mean...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What is that man Aaron thinking...?)

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Dayna, I have a separate favor to ask you.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: No...

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: We can get a little closer to what happened ten years ago.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: I'll handle that. Stay out of it, Sister. Just focus on governing.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Dayna, I understand your wishes. But I am not only the Empire's ruler. I am Father's daughter and your older sister.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: All this time, I've thought about what I could do from my position, and I've worked toward it. Now, at last, I think I can do something...

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Why are you telling me not to?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Enough. I don't want to hear it. If you're finished talking, go back now.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Wait, you there...?
(Just then, Dayna goes after a woman who is backing away and catches her.)

lines.speaker: 여성
lines.text: I seem to have picked the wrong moment. Ahaha...

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Not at all, Chloris. You've come at just the right time.
(As the woman called Chloris shakes her head, her emerald-tinged blond hair moves with it.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh? Chloris? That name...

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: %s, you've met Chloris before, haven't you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, the Magic Academy's headmistress! You looked different then, so I didn't recognize you.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Please forget that appearance. The students keep teasing me about their teacher destroying the school. It's embarrassing.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, all right...

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Chloris, you came to see me, didn't you? Has something happened to Shiina...?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: There is nothing wrong with the princess... I mean, Shiina. However...

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Chloris, I'd like to hear what you have to say. Shall we move somewhere else?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Yes, Your Majesty.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Dayna, if possible, I'd like to hear this over Jelic's desserts. Would that be all right?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Do what you like. You always do.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Thank you, Dayna. Chloris and %s, let's go see the Mongle Mongle Guild's pastry chef.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, all right...

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Dayna, you'll listen to me, won't you?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Ugh, fine. I'll listen. Happy now?

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Jelic's food truly is happiness itself... It's such a shame this flavor can only be found in Esnil.

lines.speaker: 젤릭
lines.text: You flatter me, Your Majesty.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Thank you from me too, Jelic. The students asked me to tell you they enjoyed the bread.

lines.speaker: 젤릭
lines.text: It was worth gathering the guild members to bake it, then. Haha. Oh, here, take this.

lines.speaker: 젤릭
lines.text: It's nothing much, but this is a food-storage pouch made using a method from my home village. I've packed a few things to eat. Please take it with you when you leave.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: We'll enjoy these too, Jelic.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Narsha definitely has one of those.)

lines.speaker: 젤릭
lines.text: I have more food to prepare, so I'll take my leave. Enjoy your time together.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Jelic would make a fine imperial pastry chef...

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Sister, stop talking like that.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: I was talking to myself. And what's wrong with complimenting Jelic?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: You know why I can't stay in the imperial palace, yet you say that to him?

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: You left by your own choice. Even though I told you it was all right...

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Does everything become all right just because you say so?!

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: That's your problem, Sister.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: I could have kept you there by order of Kaina Dawn Silvaria, Empress of the Silvaria Empire. I respected your wishes, and yet you...

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: And? Are you going to issue an order here?

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: There's no reason I couldn't.
(Dayna and Kaina continue airing their grievances without pause. Caught between them, Chloris looks deeply uneasy.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you all right?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: I'm fine...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Your Majesty, Dayna. Didn't we come here to hear Chloris's story?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: I'm sorry, Chloris. My sister distracted me.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Forgive me, Chloris. It's been a while since I spent time with my sister.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Ahaha, no, it's all right. I'm fine.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (She doesn't look fine at all...)

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Chloris, Shiina sent you here because you want to find Zephyros, correct?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: How did Your Majesty...? Ah... Right.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Zephyros went away to obtain materials for his magical research, but he hasn't returned in over a fortnight.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: So I came to ask Dayna for help.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Could he be staying a little longer to continue his research?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: No, that's not it... It's a little embarrassing to say...

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Since the accident at the academy festival, I've been able to sense Zephyros's magic.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: I could feel it from so far away that I still sensed him when he went to Lifthrasir.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Because of the Windy Seed?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: I think so.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Chloris, I'm sorry...

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Pardon?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: I'd like to help you too, but I think I must also assist Her Majesty...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (So Dayna is going to do what Her Majesty asked after all...)

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: No, it's all right. I'll find someone else. Thank you just for hearing me out. I can't go to Lifthrasir myself...

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Ah...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why? You're an elf. Why can't you go to Alfheim?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: It's a long story.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Chloris, it's all right. There is nowhere a citizen of the Silvaria Empire cannot go.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: But...

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: %s, please take care of Chloris.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Pardon?

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Help her find Zephyros. It will bring you closer to the answers you seek. I say this through my ability, so you may trust it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Understood. With Your Majesty's assurance, things surely won't go wrong.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Your Majesty, is it really all right for me to go?

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Even the most arrogant person knows better than to lay a hand on someone under the Empress's protection. Go without fear.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Hearing that, I regret hesitating at all. I knew I had to go myself to find him.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Do not forget that you are a citizen of the Silvaria Empire. When you're ready, go to the Nereis Gateway and speak to Notos. He will open the gate.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: What...? Notos? Did you say Notos? Notos... Aaah...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Why is Chloris reacting like that?)

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: U-understood, Your Majesty.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: It was lovely to meet you both. I have something to discuss with my prickly little sister, so I'll take my leave.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Sigh. My foolish sister has caused you trouble. Sister, five minutes. Not a moment more.
(As the two disappear somewhere to talk, Chloris wipes away a cold sweat.)

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: I truly never imagined I'd meet Her Majesty like this...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Neither did I.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Thank you again for what happened at the academy festival. Oh, the festival will have a new name now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Daphne...

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Um, %s. Her Majesty did ask, but are you really all right with accompanying me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's all right. There's something I'd like to investigate too.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: If you're involved, %s, it must be important.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Her Majesty came to Esnil to speak to Dayna about a new witch who will soon appear.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: And since she told me to accompany you...

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: That means the witch could be in Lifthrasir.
(For an instant, Chloris looks resolute, as though she has made a decision.)

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: %s, I'll return to the academy and pack. Come to the Nereis Gateway when you're ready.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. I'll go to the Nereis Gateway once I'm prepared.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I thought the academy festival business was over, but now it's continuing like this... As always, I suppose I can only go and see.)

steps.name: Toward Alfheim
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Notos] in 「Nereis Gatewayway」 and use the 「Lifthrasir」 gate.
2. When you arrive in 「Lifthrasir」, turn in the quest to [Lashur].

lines.text: (The Nereis Gateway is once again crowded with people traveling between eastern and western Freios.)
(Pushing through the crowd toward the large building ahead, I see Chloris from behind, apparently worrying about something.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Headmistress?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: You're here, %s?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You arrived early.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: I only just got here myself. Oh, um... Would you please call me Chloris?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: It's a little embarrassing to be called headmistress or principal outside the academy.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then shall I address you as I do Dayna? I'd still like to be respectful.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: That sounds good. I'll do the same for you, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There's a lounge inside. You could have waited there.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Notos is inside...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why is that a problem?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: ...I made a mistake with Notos once...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't tell me you mistook him for Zephyros and confessed your love, hugged him from behind, or gave him a present?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: How did you...?
(Chloris looks flustered, then tries to act as though nothing is wrong.)

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: N-nothing happened! Oh, someone's coming out.
(The Gateway Center's door opens, and someone steps out. Spotting %s, he offers a warm greeting.)

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Welcome, %s. Huh? Chloris?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Notos.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Notos... It's been a while.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: How many years has it been?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Quite a few.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: How have you been? I heard you became the Magic Academy's headmistress...

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: I've been well, thank you.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Have you recovered from your troubles at the academy festival?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Yes, well... I came to the gateway because I have business in Lifthrasir.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: I've finished checking the gate on Her Majesty's orders. Please use the gateway inside.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: It was nothing. I'm simply grateful you always look after my younger brother.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: I'm sorry, Notos.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Pardon?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Ah, Notos must not know about Zephyros yet.)

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Oh, right...

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: You needn't apologize for breaking up with Zephyros. I'm sure he was the one at fault. Hahaha.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: That's right. Zephy was the one... I'm sorry. I didn't mean to speak ill of him...

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: It's all right. You're saying it because you care about him.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Notos, I'll be going now. We're short on time...
(Chloris turns and hurries toward the gateway.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Chloris...

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: %s, don't worry about me. Hurry after Chloris.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you. I'll see you again later.
(Chloris stands looking at the gate, which hums with powerful magic.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Chloris, here you are.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: I was preparing myself.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: It's been a very long time since I went to Alfheim.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I hope this isn't rude to say, but you look a little anxious.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: I am. A little. I wasn't welcome in Alfheim. Though the Silvaria Empire didn't exactly welcome me warmly either.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh? Why not?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: I'm half human and half elf. There weren't many places that would accept me because of that.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: I'm all right now. Simply being at the academy has allowed me to forget about it.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: My fellow mages who teach the students don't seem to mind, and many students look up to me.
(Chloris smiles brightly. The anxiety from a moment ago is nowhere to be seen.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You really love the academy, don't you?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Of course.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: I'm a little sad that I never got to enroll, but I'm so happy to be there even in this way.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Though I still hate going to work when there's too much to do.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Haha. I think everyone feels that way.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh?
(As we approach the gate, the surroundings suddenly grow dark.)

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: You felt that too, didn't you, %s?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It just went dark in front of us, didn't it?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Yes. Someone is giving us a silent warning not to come.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: It seems they've set a little device here... But they've picked the wrong person.
(Chloris closes her eyes and reaches out. Cold wind from the Void Sea flows in and coils around her hand. A plant stem sprouts within it.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is...
(At Chloris's gesture, leaves fall from the stem, ride the wind, and circle the gate.)
(The darkened surroundings slowly return to the clear, bright Nereis Gateway.)

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: That should do for now.
(As Chloris smiles, the wind and plant stem around her hand slowly disappear.)

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: This is another effect of the Windy Seed... I can cast magic without holding a staff or spellbook now. I consider it a rather nice gift.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Space and time were slightly distorted here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Since the academy festival, I've felt something strange that I can't put into words.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: I read old spellbooks to find the cause, but there was no clear answer. All I can do is experience it, sense it, and learn...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A spirit of time I once met remembered Zephyros transforming into a being like itself.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: If a spirit told you that... then it's certain Zephyros was affected by time. Hmm...

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: %s, shall we go now? Talking here won't give us any answers.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right...
(Chloris swallows nervously and slowly enters the gate to Lifthrasir. %s follows behind.)
Wow!
(High above the Void Sea, someone watches the two disappear through the gate and exclaims in wonder.)
Wow, wow, wow!! A lock! A lock!
It's the real lock from my memories! Wow, wow!!

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: So this is Lifthrasir...
(As Chloris speaks, a village washed in purple spreads out beneath a clear blue sky.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wow...
(Among buildings steeped in the atmosphere of an elven village stands an enormous statue of an elf raising a sword toward the sky.)

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: That's a statue of the legendary elven hero. Their name isn't known, but they fought the demons that appeared on Freios.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: If you'd like to know more, you could attend one of Professor Theodore's lectures.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'd like to, if I get the chance.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Or you could ask the villagers.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Really? Hmm... Oh, this place...

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It feels a little different from a human town. The air seems clearer and cleaner...

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: It's because of the nearby forest. Crystal Moon Forest is influenced by spirits... But what's that orange ribbon on your wrist?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh...? When did that get there?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: It must have fallen from someone else's clothes and caught on you as we entered the gate. Don't worry too much about it. For now, let's...
(Just as Chloris is about to continue, a blond elf boy who appears to be a Lifthrasir resident approaches.)

lines.speaker: 엘프 소년
lines.text: Welcome to Lifthrasir!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you live here?

lines.speaker: 엘프 소년
lines.text: I'm Coren! Nice to meet you! I'll show you around! Our village is the birthplace of the legendary elven hero...
(The boy who introduced himself as Coren meets Chloris's eyes.)

lines.speaker: 코렌
lines.text: The birthplace of the elven hero... Aaaaah...
(The instant Coren meets Chloris's eyes, he begins backing away. Then he turns and runs.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why did he run off in the middle of the introduction?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Because of me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What? Surely not...

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Freios elves instinctively sense beings with mixed blood. They see it as something impure, rather than simply different.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: That boy probably did too. It's been ingrained in them since ancient times.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Usually, they just give me hostile looks... If he's running away like that, perhaps something has happened.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Still, that's no way to treat a person.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Humans and elves think differently.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Does that justify discrimination?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Though I know it isn't only elves...

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: %s, I'd rather not discuss this here. We have something more important to do right now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, I'm sorry. I wasn't thinking.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: It's all right. Things like this will keep happening as we talk to Lifthrasir's people.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Please focus on what you came here to do, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Thank you. Shall we go ask someone else, then?

steps.name: Exploring the Elf Village
steps.objective: Talk to [Lashur], [Coren], and [Lunton] in 「Lifthrasir」. Finally, turn in the quest to [Lif].

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Oh... That man...
(Chloris stops walking and looks at a human man.)
(A man with an expensive coat thrown loosely over his shoulders and glittering accessories notices Chloris and gives her a broad smile.)
Oh, Headmistress Chloris. What brings you here?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: What brings you here, Lashur?

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: Hahaha! What else? I go wherever there's money to be made.

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: Lifthrasir's village chief wants to distribute local goods in the Empire, so I came to take a look first.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Chloris, if you know him, please introduce us.

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: You don't know me? Then allow me to enlighten you. I'm Lashur, head of [Richberry], the Empire's greatest trading company. Remember it.

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: Tell people you know me, and you won't lose out, at least. That's the kind of man I am.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What incredible confidence.)

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: I was about to introduce you, but you beat me to it.

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: An introduction is always most impressive when you do it yourself, Headmistress.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: %s, Lashur donates large sums of Ely every quarter for the students.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's impressive.

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: Hahaha! It's nothing. As Richberry's head, it's only natural. But I'm curious about you. Please introduce yourself.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, I'm...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I briefly introduce myself to Lashur.)

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: %s? I think I've heard of you. If I have, you must be someone special. Hahaha! A pleasure to meet you.

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: I have some time before meeting Chief Lif, and I'm bored. Headmistress, would you and your friend talk with me for a while?

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: Of course, I won't take your time for nothing. I'll compensate you generously.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: I'm sorry, Lashur. We have something to do.

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: Hehe. Can't be helped.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Have you seen the chairman here, by any chance?

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: The chairman? Chairman Zephyros came too? I only just arrived, so I haven't seen him.

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: Has something happened?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Nothing you need to worry about. We're rather busy, so we'll take our leave.

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: All right, Headmistress. See you later. I'll bring something the students will enjoy!

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Thank you, Lashur.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Goodbye.

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: Have a pleasant journey too, %s.
(Lashur raises a hand in a stylish farewell, then disappears into the village.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: He seems unusual.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Not just a little. Very. Talking to him can be tiring, but he's a good man.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: He builds facilities for the students and donates money for teaching materials. I didn't expect to see him here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: It seems there are no more imperial acquaintances here. Let's ask the elves too.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Then we can go see the village chief, Lif.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right, Chloris.
(Coren stares at %s and their companion as they approach.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Your name was Coren, right?

lines.speaker: 코렌
lines.text: Huh? Yes...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why did you suddenly run away?

lines.speaker: 코렌
lines.text: I'm sorry. I know I did something wrong. I knew it was wrong, but I was scared.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: It was because of me, wasn't it?

lines.speaker: 코렌
lines.text: Yes. A little...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why?
(Chloris takes %s by the shoulder and shakes her head.)

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: %s, this is Alfheim.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: I understand, Coren. If you've realized it was wrong, that's enough.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It reminds me of the Empire's people who refused to see someone like Narsha as a person, calling her beastfolk. And elves treat mixed-blood people like this too...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Have I ever treated someone with prejudice without realizing it...?)

lines.speaker: 코렌
lines.text: I won't do it again. It's been so long since I saw someone of mixed blood. And long ago...

lines.speaker: 코렌
lines.text: Ah...

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Did something happen?

lines.speaker: 코렌
lines.text: Something bad happened in the village, that's all.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: There's something I'd like to ask.

lines.speaker: 코렌
lines.text: As long as it's not about the past.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: I'm looking for a friend. He came to Lifthrasir before us, but we've lost contact with him.

lines.speaker: 코렌
lines.text: Really? Tell me what he looks like. I have a good memory, so I'll know right away.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: He's Notos's twin. Shall I describe him?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: I'll do it. They're twins, but a little different.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: He's a human man with peridot-green eyes. He wears black glasses when he reads.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: His expression is usually stern, but sometimes he gives a gentle smile. He should be wearing a mage's outfit with the imperial crest.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: His name is Zephyros...

lines.speaker: 코렌
lines.text: Ah, that man! I think I saw him...
(As Coren searches his memory, he begins to look confused.)

lines.speaker: 코렌
lines.text: Sorry... I can't remember clearly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It doesn't seem deliberate...)

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: It's all right. So many people visit that you may not remember everyone.
(A hint of disappointment crosses Chloris's face.)

lines.speaker: 코렌
lines.text: How long will you stay in our village?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: We'll leave as soon as we find him.

lines.speaker: 코렌
lines.text: If he was dressed as a mage, is he one?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Yes. A mage...
(Coren's eyes begin sparkling at the word mage.)

lines.speaker: 코렌
lines.text: Wow, a mage! I've never seen one before! Amazing!

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Coren, if you remember anything later, please tell me. Then I'll show you a little magic.

lines.speaker: 코렌
lines.text: Really? You mean it?! All right, big sis!

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Big sis...? Ahaha...
(Chloris gives a wry smile at Coren's change of attitude.)

lines.speaker: 코렌
lines.text: What's your name, big sis?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Call me... Chloris. If that's too long, Chloe is fine.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Chloris...)

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Then we'll go speak to another elf. Thank you, Coren.

lines.speaker: 코렌
lines.text: Okay!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Chloris, shall we go?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: All right...
(A tall, silver-haired young elf stares at %s and their companion as they approach.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll ask this time.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Excuse me. You live in Lifthrasir, right? Could I ask you something?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Excuse me?
W-what is it? I'm shy around strangers, and I'm a little slow to speak... I'm sorry...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's all right.

lines.speaker: 런튼
lines.text: Thank you for visiting our village. I'm Lunton, the keeper of Crystal Moon Forest. Have you come from the Empire?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes... From the east. Are you all right?

lines.speaker: 런튼
lines.text: Yes, I'm fine. What would you like to ask...? Is it about your companion?
(Lunton and Chloris meet each other's eyes for an instant.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A friend arrived in Lifthrasir before us, but we haven't been able to contact him.

lines.speaker: 런튼
lines.text: People of the Empire may wonder why, but the elves of Alfheim see those of mixed blood...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You don't need to explain that. There's really no problem with them...

lines.speaker: 런튼
lines.text: In our village, something bad involving a person of mixed blood...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Even so... Ah, never mind. This is Alfheim...

lines.speaker: 런튼
lines.text: I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Has someone named Zephyros visited the forest or village recently?

lines.speaker: 런튼
lines.text: Zephyros? I don't know the name, but if you describe him, I might recognize him...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah... Chloris. I think you'll need to describe Zephyros...

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: He's human, taller than I am. He has peridot-green eyes and wears black glasses.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: His expression is usually stern, but sometimes he gives a gentle smile. He should be wearing a mage's outfit with the imperial crest.

lines.speaker: 런튼
lines.text: Does he carry something like a spellbook?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Oh, have you seen him?

lines.speaker: 런튼
lines.text: One moment. Huh...?
(Lunton looks startled and confused.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What's happening...?)

lines.speaker: 런튼
lines.text: I'm sorry. Mages do visit occasionally... But all of a sudden, I can't remember...

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: It can't be helped. So many people visit this place...

lines.speaker: 런튼
lines.text: If anything comes back to me later, I'll let you know immediately.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Lunton.

lines.speaker: 런튼
lines.text: Yes... Then I hope you have a pleasant journey... I need to go on patrol...

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: A pleasant journey...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Chloris, shall we go?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: All right...

steps.name: An Error in Memory
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Lif] in 「Lifthrasir」, then use the village portal to reach 「Crystal Moon Forest」.
2. After the strange encounter in 「Crystal Moon Forest」, defeat [Merry Amdusias] and [Despair-Bringing Cubi], then turn in the quest to [Lunton] in 「Crystal Moon Forest」.

lines.text: (A small elf girl, busily running about, notices %s and their companion approaching.)
Welcome to Lifthrasir! Questions are always welcome. If you're curious about anything, come see Lif. Ah...
(The elf girl who introduced herself as Lif stops moving when she sees Chloris.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Chloris again...)

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Hello, Chief Lif.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Chief?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: You called me chief, and I nearly answered without thinking. Welcome, Headmistress Chloris.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Yes, Director. It's been a while. We haven't met since the academy festival, have we?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: That's right. Thank you for inviting me to the festival two years ago.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: And please accept my apologies for the villagers' rudeness.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: It's all right. I'm used to it. Please don't worry.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: They're all good children, but... They carry some trauma from what happened before.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: I heard a little in passing. Something happened in the village?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: An old matter. Nothing you need concern yourself with, Headmistress. Would you introduce your companion?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: This is %s. You may have heard of them: a hero who helped Xerenis Academy and resolved troubles on other continents as well.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, I wouldn't go that far.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Ah! So you're the one. I've heard about you.
(Suddenly, Lif's eyes sparkle.)

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Why not spend your old age in Lifthrasir? A new hero laid to rest alongside our legendary champion... Has a nice ring to it, doesn't it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm still very much alive, you know.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Do think about it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'd rather not start planning for that yet.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: What a shame. Hehe.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (She's already thinking of making money from it. Quite a character.)

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Headmistress, what brings you here? We received an official request for cooperation from the Silvaria Empire. Is it about that?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Yes, that's right.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Let's see.
(Lif takes out a sheet of paper and begins reading.)

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: The Lifthrasir administration is requested to cooperate. Please provide visitors Chloris and %s with information concerning one visitor to the village...

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Even in the Empire's earliest days, we never had anything like this. What's going on?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Director, the Empire's earliest days?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Ahaha, it's just a figure of speech. Enough silly jokes. Tell me about the person you're looking for.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's Zephyros. Chloris will describe him.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: He's human, taller than I am. He has peridot-green eyes and wears black glasses.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: His expression is usually stern, but sometimes he gives a gentle smile. He should be wearing a mage's outfit with the imperial crest.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: He wasn't that gentle, though. I remember thinking I'd never seen a human smile so awkwardly...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, Zephyros was here?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: He identified himself and said he was gathering materials for magical tools, so I allowed it. Only because he needed a tiny amount. Otherwise, I wouldn't have.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: I asked him to report back with how much he gathered, but he never came.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Just in case, I told Lunton to search the forest and Coren to check the lodgings. When they couldn't find him, I assumed he'd gone straight home.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: So that wasn't it...

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Then I'll grant you access to the restricted areas of Crystal Moon Forest as well as the public areas.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: I'll tell Lunton, the forest keeper, too. If you think you're getting lost, find him at the rest area in the center of the forest.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Thank you, Director.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: They say a favor should be repaid twice over, don't they? I'll look forward to it.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Of course.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: I have too much work to join you in the forest. Here's a map, and there are signposts outside. You shouldn't get lost.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: You've done so much for us already. The thought is more than enough.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: I'll gather information here too, so don't worry too much. It will work out.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then we'll head into the forest. Chief...
(Lif meets my eyes and winks.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I mean, Director Lif.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: We'll see you later, Director.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Not at all...

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Oh, wait... Wh-what's this? Something feels strange in the village...

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: It certainly feels different outside the village.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So this is Crystal Moon Forest.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I wanted to see it for myself when I saw all that purple beyond the village, but it's even more beautiful than I imagined.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: It's a forest full of good energy... Yet something feels odd.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: An elven forest that has existed since ancient times has become a park. I knew the forest had changed as the village developed, but... It feels strange.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: And the fact that I'm here, too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't worry too much.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: I should try not to. When else would I get to visit Crystal Moon Forest? I'm only here thanks to Zephy.
(As Chloris finishes her self-deprecating joke, people pass by on their way to see the forest.)

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: It seems a little early, but there are quite a few people out walking.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. There are people across the lake too.
(A group with an air unlike ordinary tourists surveys the area on the opposite side of the lake.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Have they lost something?)

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: %s, I have a favor to ask.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes? What is it?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: I'd like to stand here in silence and take in the scenery. Just for a moment.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, I'd like that too. Let's enjoy the view together.
(Chloris nods, then turns and gazes at Crystal Moon Forest for a long while.)

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Whew. All done. Shall we go now?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: According to the map, there's a cathedral this way.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: The cathedral is a little far. Shall we leave it until last? Oh, %s. Do you know this child?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who?
(Chloris points to a little girl tugging at %s's clothes.)

lines.speaker: 여자아이
lines.text: Wow! Hello, Lock! Hello!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh? When did you get here?
(The girl, wearing a helmet that looks strangely familiar, smiles brightly.)

lines.speaker: 여자아이
lines.text: Lock! I missed you!! Didn't you miss me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is she talking about...? Do you know me?

lines.speaker: 여자아이
lines.text: Yes! I do, I do!

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: She seems to know you, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I've never seen her before.

lines.speaker: 여자아이
lines.text: It's my first time seeing you too, Lock! Hehe...

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Little one, will you tell us your name?

lines.speaker: 여자아이
lines.text: Mordred!
(The girl who introduced herself as Mordred hops up and down. No one notices something fall from her clothes.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why do you call me Lock?
(Mordred pouts and scratches her head.)

lines.speaker: 모드레드
lines.text: Hmm. If you're not a lock, what are you? A key?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: A key...?
(The instant Mordred says 'key,' the violet glow of Crystal Moon Forest is engulfed in darkness. The forest begins shaking rapidly.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh, I'm dizzy... Chloris...?
(Chloris stands motionless, as though at the boundary of time. Other beings slip into the gap and catch Mordred as she tries to move.)

lines.speaker: 수상한 여성
lines.text: ...You. Why are you awake? Everything in this space has stopped. Why are you alone...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who...?

lines.speaker: 수상한 여성
lines.text: Mordred, I told you to stay beside me, didn't I?

lines.speaker: 모드레드
lines.text: Sorry. Hehe.

lines.speaker: 수상한 여성
lines.text: Sigh... We'll have to change the plan, Merlin.

lines.speaker: 수상한 남성
lines.text: Understood...
(The man called Merlin nods and puts Mordred over his shoulder. The suspicious woman approaches %s, who is struggling with dizziness.)

lines.speaker: 수상한 여성
lines.text: I don't know who you are... But you mustn't remember us. I'll make it as though you never saw us. This is for everyone's sake.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh... Uuugh...
(The woman holds a pendant close to %s's eyes. As she tilts her hand, it slowly swings from side to side.)

lines.speaker: 수상한 여성
lines.text: Thoughts of the living. Return to the primordial air before you become memories...
(At the woman's words, a dense shadow flows from the pendant and swallows the light remaining around %s.)

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: The cathedral is a little far. Shall we leave it until last?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What? This feels familiar...)

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: %s, what's wrong?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: We were looking at the forest scenery here, right?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Yes. Was your mind somewhere else?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, not exactly... I'm sure something was here. Huh? What's this?
(Chloris picks up something lying at %s's feet.)

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: A letter...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There's a name on the envelope.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: From your friend and brother, Notos... Zephy must have received Notos's letter.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then Zephyros was here... Huh? Oh!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Didn't you notice anything strange?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lunton and Coren couldn't remember Zephyros. They seemed certain they knew him, but then said they couldn't remember.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: You're right. Huh?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: I hadn't even realized that until this moment. And there was a little girl here, wasn't there?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A little girl?
(Images of unfamiliar figures arise in my mind, then vanish in an instant.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Mord... red? She said her name was Mordred. Ah, I think I remember. She appeared suddenly and called me a lock... a key...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: And the helmet she was wearing was definitely Weiss's...

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Stay calm... Do you remember everything that happened?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I think it's coming back. A group came looking for the girl...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I tell Chloris every memory that comes back to me.)

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: I think the pieces are beginning to fit. The woman with the pendant made us forget that we'd just met them.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Likewise, she made the villagers forget Zephyros.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: I don't know whether Mordred dropped this letter deliberately or by accident... But touching it allowed us to recall the hidden memories.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Thank goodness there was magic left in this letter...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: We have to find those people quickly. Others could be in danger.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Yes. Shall we start over there? I sense powerful magic in that direction.
(Chloris turns and points. At that moment, wind from deep in the forest approaches with an eerie chill.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think there's a group over there that won't be pleased to see us.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Yes... We'd better be prepared.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then let's go...

steps.name: A Shadow over the Forest
steps.objective: Defeat [Lovely Hamama] and [White Hedgehog] in 「Crystal Moon Forest」, then report to [Lunton] in 「Crystal Moon Forest」.

lines.text: 「An announcement from Lifthrasir!」

lines.speaker: 런튼
lines.text: Director?
(Lif's voice rings throughout Crystal Moon Forest.)

lines.speaker: 리프의 목소리
lines.text: 「All visitors, return to the village immediately!! This is an emergency!」

lines.speaker: 리프의 목소리
lines.text: 「I repeat. All visitors, return to the village immediately!! Forest keepers, evacuate the visitors in the forest to the village at once.」
(Lif's voice echoes through Crystal Moon Forest, warning of danger.)

lines.speaker: 숲지기 1
lines.text: What's happened? For the director to make an announcement like this...

lines.speaker: 런튼
lines.text: I heard she could carry her voice throughout the forest...
(Before Lunton finishes speaking, a deep darkness begins settling over the violet Crystal Moon Forest.)

lines.speaker: 숲지기 1
lines.text: Wh-what's going on?

lines.speaker: 숲지기 2
lines.text: Something is definitely wrong. Lunton, let's go!

lines.speaker: 런튼
lines.text: You two, please take any visitors you see back with you.

lines.speaker: 숲지기 2
lines.text: Lunton, what are you going to do?

lines.speaker: 런튼
lines.text: Drive off those animals gathering over there.

lines.speaker: 숲지기 1
lines.text: What animals...? Huh?!
(The forest keepers spot animals rushing toward them in response to the magic. Startled, they hesitate, and Lunton hurriedly pushes them forward.)

lines.speaker: 런튼
lines.text: I'll drive off the animals and protect anyone who comes to this rest area.

lines.speaker: 숲지기 1
lines.text: Will you be all right alone?

lines.speaker: 런튼
lines.text: Handling animals is what I do best... Go, quickly!
(The other forest keepers nod and hurry toward the shortcut.)

lines.speaker: 런튼
lines.text: I said that, but how am I going to drive off so many Hamamas and hedgehogs...?

lines.speaker: 런튼
lines.text: I'll try, at least.
(As Lunton struggles to fend off the many animals, two people appear before him.)

lines.speaker: 런튼
lines.text: It's dangerous here... You two...?
(Thorny stems rise from the ground, and leaves ride the wind to block the animals' path. Some startled animals retreat.)

lines.speaker: 런튼
lines.text: Magic...

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: It's too dangerous to face this alone.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lunton, are you all right?

lines.speaker: 런튼
lines.text: I'm fine. But you two...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't worry about us. Let's drive away the animals first.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: There are other ominous beings here besides the animals. %s, please handle those.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right, Chloris! Lunton, stand back. We'll take over!

steps.name: Crystal Moon Forest Restricted Area
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Lunton] in 「Crystal Moon Forest」, then enter the 「Crystal Moon Forest Restricted Area」.
2. Once the events in the 「Crystal Moon Forest Restricted Area」 are over, return to [Lunton] in 「Lifthrasir」 and turn in the quest.

lines.text: (Through the two's efforts, the animals and other beings threatening the people are driven away.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Whew. We can catch our breath now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lunton, are you all right?

lines.speaker: 런튼
lines.text: I'm all right. Thanks to you, the visitors in the forest can return to the village.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: That's a relief.
(As Chloris looks at Lunton, the beautiful flowers and stems created by her magic disappear.)

lines.speaker: 런튼
lines.text: ...What beautiful magic. I never knew someone could wield flower, tree, and wind magic so beautifully...

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: My skill is nothing to boast about. And this wasn't even my own power to begin with...

lines.speaker: 런튼
lines.text: Not at all. You're remarkable...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Chloris, we should check with Lunton, shouldn't we?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Yes. Lunton, do you remember Zephyros?

lines.speaker: 런튼
lines.text: Yes, I... remember. The moment Director Lif told me we needed to find him, something felt strange.

lines.speaker: 런튼
lines.text: Then my memories suddenly returned.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: As I thought...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It seems to have happened when we took hold of the letter.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Please continue, Lunton.

lines.speaker: 런튼
lines.text: It was as though light shone on memories hidden behind blackout curtains. I remembered guiding that male mage into the forest. His name was definitely Zephyros...

lines.speaker: 런튼
lines.text: He looks like this, doesn't he?
(Lunton crouches and uses a fallen twig to draw a face. Chloris looks at the drawing and bursts into laughter.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A mage with long blue hair, glasses, and a thoroughly disgruntled expression...

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Ahahaha! That's Zephyros. You've captured him perfectly. So where did you take him?

lines.speaker: 런튼
lines.text: There is a place in the forest where the moon's energy is especially strong. Access is restricted to those with Director Lif's permission. She granted it, so I took him there.

lines.speaker: 런튼
lines.text: Come to think of it, I believe both he and my memories disappeared there... That was several days ago now...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lunton, could you tell us where it is? It isn't on the map, is it?

lines.speaker: 런튼
lines.text: Here. This way.
(Lunton takes a pen from his pocket and marks an X on the map in %s's hand.)

lines.speaker: 런튼
lines.text: I'll guide you.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: No. Please follow Director Lif's instructions, Lunton.

lines.speaker: 런튼
lines.text: I am a keeper of Crystal Moon Forest. Tending to this place is my duty and calling. Whatever has happened here...

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Think about the best thing you can do now. There's nothing an ordinary elf could do by going there.

lines.speaker: 런튼
lines.text: Ah...
(Lunton seems to realize something at Chloris's words and nods.)

lines.speaker: 런튼
lines.text: Understood.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: I'm sorry. I appreciate your wish to help. Or perhaps...

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: You can help us twice as much next time.

lines.speaker: 런튼
lines.text: Pardon?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Half-elves repay help twice over. We have so few chances to receive it...

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: And you're offering to help a half-elf. So if you help twice as much, it'll make helping you next time more worthwhile, won't it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That logic makes no sense at all, but somehow, when you say it, Chloris, it almost does.

lines.speaker: 런튼
lines.text: Does... it?

lines.speaker: 런튼
lines.text: Then please be careful.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Thank you, Lunton.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: We'll see you later, Lunton.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Chloris?
(Chloris has her eyes closed and is murmuring unfamiliar words.)

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: I quickly prepared a spell. I don't know when we'll need it, but...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Pardon?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Just in case. Anyone who erased the memories of people throughout the village and forest is clearly no ordinary person...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you ready now?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: For now. Whew... Shall we go?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes.
(Following the map deep into Crystal Moon Forest, we find a path through undergrowth of a deeper purple than anywhere else.)
(After pushing through the vegetation for a while, Chloris, who is leading, stops.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Chloris, what's wrong?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: We're inside distorted spacetime. It's a little different from what was at the gateway.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: It felt so natural that I only just noticed... Ah...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who made this place...? How do we get out? Hmm... It doesn't look like the Reverse Side...

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Do you see it? Over there...
(A wall that was invisible a moment ago stands where Chloris points.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A glowing green wall... I've seen this wall before. It's...
(As we approach the wall, a familiar person appears from behind it.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hilda?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Is Hilda the witch Her Majesty said would appear...?)

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: You remember my name? No, that's not the point. Why are you here?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Why do you keep finding me...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's what I'd like to ask you.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: D-don't come closer! You mustn't...
(Hilda reaches out, and a new wall of green light rises before %s.)

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I'm dizzy. It's all because of you...

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: %s, who are you talking to? And this wall...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Chloris, can't you see the person in front of us?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: I could only hear a voice, not see anyone... But this woman in front of us...
(Struggling, Hilda clings to the wall and raises her head to look at Chloris.)

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Headmistress, please tell %s to step back.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: %s, step back for now. Then we'll talk.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right, Chloris. Hilda, I'll do as you ask.
(Still complaining of dizziness, Hilda sinks to the ground.)

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Hilda, was it? You know me.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I saw you when I hid in the academy's main building for a little while...

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Our teachers and staff are all skilled mages. To think none of them noticed you hiding in the academy... Though I didn't notice either.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hilda, were you hiding here too?
(Hilda looks uncomfortable, then nods.)

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Why are you hiding?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I can't tell you. I'm sorry... Please just leave quietly... Keep walking backward, and you'll get out again. So please...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If you keep hiding here, and we keep searching for someone, we'll run into you again.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: The chairman?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: You know Zephyros?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: A powerful magic appeared and disappeared. Was that the chairman? I didn't actually know who it was... Could it be...?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I think another witch took him. But why...?
(Before Hilda finishes, the green walls and everything else in sight begin shaking as though distorted.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wh-what is this?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: This is...
(Everything in view slowly fractures like breaking glass. Even Hilda at its center.)

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Memories are time arranged in sequence... The one trying to enter now is the Witch of Memory... She probably needed someone who holds the power of time.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: That's all I can tell you. Goodbye now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hilda...

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: %s, I have to live. I can't die at a witch's hands!!
(Hilda runs toward the green wall farther inside. It takes her in, then vanishes from the spot.)
(The instant Hilda disappears, someone's hidden figure slowly emerges through the shaking, fractured scenery.)
(Shadows flicker in and out around the woman. Unconcerned, she keeps toying with the pendant in her hand.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You're...

lines.speaker: 수상한 여성
lines.text: I thought the cat I was looking for was inside the box, but it seems to have escaped...

lines.speaker: 수상한 여성
lines.text: Disappearing is a better choice than dying for nothing. Almost worthy of praise...
(Still murmuring cryptically, the woman meets %s's eyes.)

lines.speaker: 수상한 여성
lines.text: Have you come to stop me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What are you talking about?

lines.speaker: 수상한 여성
lines.text: I'm asking whether you'll stop me as you stopped Arthur from reaching Azrael.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Arthur?

lines.speaker: 수상한 여성
lines.text: Arthur is another name I use for him...

lines.speaker: 수상한 여성
lines.text: I don't resent you for failing to become a key. There are plenty of other methods besides Arthur's...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Weiss?

lines.speaker: 수상한 여성
lines.text: Yes. My Arthur is the Weiss you know, who has already vanished from this world.

lines.speaker: 수상한 여성
lines.text: But why can you move? You should be frozen, like that woman...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Chloris?!
(Looking where the suspicious woman points, I find Chloris frozen with her hand outstretched.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Chloris?!

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: My body won't move... This is... Ugh...
(Chloris barely manages to open her mouth, her face twisted in pain.)

lines.speaker: 수상한 여성
lines.text: I wonder how long an elven mage can endure this distorted spacetime...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What have you done...? Binding...?

lines.speaker: 수상한 여성
lines.text: No. I merely broke off fragments of time and space from various worlds and overlaid them here. The moment something that should not be here exists...

lines.speaker: 수상한 여성
lines.text: Here I am explaining something I needn't explain.

lines.speaker: 수상한 여성
lines.text: If Mordred hadn't done something so useless, everything would already be finished... How exhausting.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Release Chloris, now!!

lines.speaker: 수상한 여성
lines.text: I don't want a complicated discussion. Go back. Forget everything. I'll make you forget it all. That would be better for you.

lines.speaker: 수상한 여성
lines.text: You have no other choice anyway.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Release Chloris. Now.
(The previously expressionless woman smiles faintly as %s tightens their grip on their weapon.)
Morgana, stop.
(A man dressed in black appears, calling the woman's name.)

lines.speaker: 모르가나
lines.text: Sigh...
(Morgana sighs and swings the pendant in her hand. Chloris, freed from her frozen state, loses her strength and sinks to the ground.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Chloris!

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Cough, cough. I'm all right. Ugh... Please help me up.
(Watching the two, Morgana quietly steps back.)

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: That woman is a half-blood too...

lines.speaker: 모르가나
lines.text: Are the preparations finished?

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: They are, but there is still a little time before the song of the star begins.
(A faint, satisfied smile crosses Morgana's face at Merlin's answer. She speaks quietly to him.)

lines.speaker: 모르가나
lines.text: Someone is coming, Merlin.

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: Pay it no mind, Morgana.
(Merlin gives a faint laugh and steps in front of Morgana. He lowers his head, and something dark red grows from his back.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wings...?
(The instant Merlin's dark red wings wrap around Morgana, he and everything around him vanish as though evaporating.)
(The strange shadows disappear as well, and the forest returns to its clear violet color.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: They vanished in an instant...

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: They seem to be preparing something.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Chloris, are you all right?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: It was temporary, so I recovered quickly... I never thought I'd feel that again. Merging with the Windy Seed was unpleasant enough...

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: I've heard the name Morgana from the students. They say she comforts and heals people troubled by painful memories.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: If this is her kind of healing, I'll pass. Erasing or distorting memories... I've already had one memory erased before.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Anyway, Morgana mentioned Weiss... Did you ever see her while you were in Eastland?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, I never saw her. But I think she really was with Weiss.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The little girl with Morgana was wearing a helmet identical to his. A smaller version, apparently...

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: I see. And...

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Since Hilda said she couldn't die at a witch's hands as she fled, Morgana must be a witch, right? And Hilda herself too...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Chloris, how did you...?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Her Majesty said a witch would appear soon, and...

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: After the academy festival accident, I stayed in Glaston briefly for treatment. When I returned, someone was waiting in the headmistress's office.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: I mentioned it earlier, didn't I? That I had a memory erased... It was the witch Daphne...
(As Chloris is about to continue, Lunton appears, running urgently toward us.)

lines.speaker: 런튼
lines.text: Are you both all right?!

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: ...%s, let's finish this conversation later.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Lunton, we're fine.

lines.speaker: 런튼
lines.text: I'm glad you seem unharmed. I was searching again for anyone who hadn't left the forest, when someone I knew appeared...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: An elf with black hair and one blue eye and one red eye, right?

lines.speaker: 런튼
lines.text: Did you see him? He grew up with me when we were children... That is...
(Lunton breaks into a cold sweat and looks distressed.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lunton, what's wrong?

lines.speaker: 런튼
lines.text: I can't remember his name. His name... It was... And how we played together... How he lived in the village...

lines.speaker: 런튼
lines.text: I know him. I'm certain... Why can't I remember...?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Don't force yourself to remember, Lunton.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It seems Morgana has done it again.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: It looks as though Morgana erased or distorted the villagers' memories of that man as well as Zephyros.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The memories of the whole village...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Chloris, I think we should go back and check.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Yes, %s. And Lunton?

lines.speaker: 런튼
lines.text: Yes...?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: You look unwell. You should go back and rest for now.

lines.speaker: 런튼
lines.text: But I have work to do...

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: ...The other forest keepers and Director Lif would want you to return too.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Shall I cast a spell here to calm your body and mind? Then you would owe me four times the help, rather than twice...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Chloris, that's almost a threat...)
(Seemingly accepting Chloris's words, Lunton quietly nods and turns.)

lines.speaker: 런튼
lines.text: Understood. Follow me.

steps.name: Checking the Error
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Lunton], [Lashur], and [Coren] in 「Lifthrasir」.
2. Discuss what happened with [Chloris] at the bench in front of [Lif], then turn in the quest to [Lif].

lines.speaker: 런튼
lines.text: ...It seems all the visitors and villagers have returned...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lunton, go home and rest for now. We'll speak to Director Lif.

lines.speaker: 런튼
lines.text: But I should still report...

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Shall we make it eight times, then?

lines.speaker: 런튼
lines.text: Understood.
(Lunton gives a small, resigned bow and enters what appears to be his home.)

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: %s, what is it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You're very practiced at that.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: It's a method I developed while teaching students. Boys in particular.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: What's wrong?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha, nothing.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then let's check on the people in the village before visiting the director.

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: I was hoping to relax, but it's so noisy. Why have Dokkalf priests come here?
(Watching the people evacuated by the forest keepers, Lashur stretches lightly.)

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: I don't know what's happening, but it doesn't look profitable.
(Then he meets the approaching adventurer's eyes.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lashur, are you all right?

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: Oh, %s and Headmistress Chloris. Finished your business?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Not yet.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It looks like nothing has happened to you, Lashur.

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: Nothing? Far from it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Pardon?

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: I've secured a distribution agreement for Lifthrasir's fine goods on excellent terms. Hahaha!

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Congratulations, Lashur.
(Lashur smiles comfortably and brushes back his hair. Apparently accustomed to this, Chloris applauds without much enthusiasm.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lashur, have you noticed anything strange during your stay in the village?

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: Let's see. Chief Lif, who seemed so cautious, suddenly wanted to finish the contract in a hurry. And a whole crowd of Dokkalf priests arrived?

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: Is it because of whatever's happening outside the village?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: It's nothing.

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: If you say so, Headmistress. Hahaha. Well, I'm sure it'll work out. I'll rest a bit and return tomorrow.

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: Stay too long after achieving your purpose, and even the scent of future money fades away.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What does that even mean...?)

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: Hehe. Well, good luck. Let's meet again when there's a big opportunity.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Until next time, Lashur.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I wonder when we'll see him again... Hmm...
(Coren runs about the village, handling complaints from inconvenienced visitors. Eventually, he seems to finish and catches his breath.)

lines.speaker: 코렌
lines.text: Whew... I can rest a little now.

lines.speaker: 코렌
lines.text: The Hamamas and hedgehogs are agitated, and animals I've never seen before have appeared. What's happening?

lines.speaker: 코렌
lines.text: I hope the forest keepers are all right...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Coren, how's the village?

lines.speaker: 코렌
lines.text: It's all right. Ah...
(Coren realizes he is unconsciously starting to back away and stops himself.)

lines.speaker: 코렌
lines.text: Sorry. I didn't mean to.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: It's all right. You didn't run away this time.

lines.speaker: 코렌
lines.text: Thanks for being kind about it. Are you two all right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: We're fine.

lines.speaker: 코렌
lines.text: Thank goodness. Some of the visitors came back frightened, so I was worried.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: You're kind, Coren.

lines.speaker: 코렌
lines.text: That's right. I'm pretty kind.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha... Oh, Coren. Do you know an elf with black hair, one blue eye, and one red eye?

lines.speaker: 코렌
lines.text: Huh? Do you and Chloris know him? I only know a little about what happened from people's stories.

lines.speaker: 코렌
lines.text: That's strange... Earlier, I remembered seeing the mage with glasses she described. But now I can't remember the story I knew.

lines.speaker: 코렌
lines.text: What's happening...?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: You remember Zephyros now?

lines.speaker: 코렌
lines.text: Yes. Lunton showed him around the forest.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Thank you, Coren.

lines.speaker: 코렌
lines.text: I'm sorry, big sis.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: It's all right. Losing your memories isn't your fault.

lines.speaker: 코렌
lines.text: It isn't, right?
(Chloris smiles gently and nods.)

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Coren, we'll be going now.

lines.speaker: 코렌
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Shall we review what we know before visiting Director Lif?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: We've heard from a few outsiders, including Lashur, and Lifthrasir residents like Lunton and Coren...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The outsiders are clearly unaffected. Only the village elves can't remember that man's name or what happened here.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Their memories of Zephyros have returned. That must be thanks to the letter.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: And since the man called Merlin told Morgana the preparations were complete, they're certainly planning something suspicious involving the village.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: The question is why...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Chloris, what about the Dokkalf priests who suddenly arrived?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Elven priests rarely travel. Dozens of Dokkalf priests, especially, would only move at the summons of a high-ranking being.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A high-ranking being's summons... Oh, Chloris?
(Where Chloris is looking, Lif is busy answering questions from a crowd.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Director Lif...

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: The director must know what that man is planning.

steps.name: Lifthrasir's Past
steps.objective: Talk to [Lif] in 「Lifthrasir」, then turn in the quest to [Clara] in 「Crystal Moon Forest」.

lines.text: (After the tourists leave, Lif catches her breath, then looks surprised to see the two approaching.)

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Are you both all right? I was worried because I couldn't find you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: We're fine. Are the other visitors all right?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Yes, everyone is safe.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Director Lif, I have something to ask. You already knew, didn't you?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: I'm not sure what you mean...

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: What happened when %s and I went into the forest... And that something else would happen too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The Dokkalf priests' sudden arrival in the village is strange as well.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Please tell us why those priests, who so rarely travel, have come.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: They said it was a cooperation agreement, but they must have separate orders. So please tell us.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: About the man traveling with the witch.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: I wanted to resolve this quietly...

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Every Lifthrasir resident lost their memories of Zephyros's arrival. Yet you alone remembered his name and what he intended to do.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: The witch who manipulates memories probably didn't fully grasp your power. Please tell us now. What happened to Zephyros...?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: I realized it very late myself. I should know everything that happens in the forest and village. Yet this power was so strong that even I couldn't recognize it.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: He wants revenge on this village. I intended to stop him myself...

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: But you couldn't.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: We'll help. I need to find him, and you need to save the village.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Tell us, Director Lif. That man is with a witch now.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: A witch...
(Lif bites her lip at the word witch.)

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: I'll tell you. Though I'm not sure where to begin...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What should I ask about first...?)

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: That child's name is Saleon. He lived in Lifthrasir with his mother.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Ten years ago, when the Empire's previous ruler died suddenly, rumors spread that a witch was responsible. As though to quell those rumors, the council's nobles began searching for a witch.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: If there was no witch, they would look for demons or Agasura instead.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: I thought Alfheim, home to the elves, would be unaffected. But one villager reported that Saleon was an elf born through the power of a dream demon.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: So that's why he called me a half-blood...

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Saleon said that to you...

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Elves can be rather insular, but I believed they wouldn't cast out neighbors who'd lived among them for so long. I was mistaken.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: The informant spread rumors to the others, and the villagers grew agitated. They even turned on me when I tried to protect the pair.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: The night I planned to send them somewhere far away, a mage from the imperial Magic Bureau appeared. Claiming to have found demons, he abducted them and dragged them into the forest.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: But demons were not what the mage wanted.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The Magic Bureau was involved here too...)

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: He wanted Saleon's power... A potion the mage carried made wings grow from the boy, wings none of us had ever seen...

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Then the mage cast a spell that amplified Saleon's power.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Frightened by his changed appearance, the villagers called him a devil and threw torches. Saleon panicked and flailed his arms, injuring one of them.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Seeing that, the mage called Saleon an evil devil, a descendant of demons, and conjured flames. At that moment, his mother Maria threw herself in front of him. To protect her son...

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Maria took the full force of the mage's spell, and her entire body caught fire. The sight shocked Saleon into unconsciousness...

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: When he opened his eyes again, he transformed into a devil, went berserk, and killed the mage... In the process, half of Crystal Moon Forest and the village burned down.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Even I, who had lived with the forest for so long, could not stop it.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Saleon apologized to me, cursed those who had hounded him, and left. That was already ten years ago...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Half the village and forest burned down? You'd never know it from looking at them now.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: I am Lifthrasir's chief. After Saleon left, I had to restore the ruined village somehow. The lives and land that the hero had saved...

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: I didn't care if every elf in Alfheim cursed me as money-mad. If selling the hero's legend would let their descendants live well, so be it.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
