lines.text: So much happened...

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: I'm sorry, Headmistress Chloris.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: You have nothing to apologize for, Director Lif.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: What happened in Lifthrasir made the rumors about mixed-blood people even worse. The last ten years have been worse than the centuries before them.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: The fault lies with the people who looked at those like me with hatred.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Chloris...)

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: I thought time would resolve it naturally. But unless you truly address something, it remains a painful memory and returns...

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Sigh...

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: A fortnight ago, I heard screams from the square and ran over. Saleon had appeared and killed someone...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who was the victim?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: The one who reported Saleon's identity, then spread rumors when things didn't go his way, and threw a torch at him...

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: He opposed Lifthrasir's growth more fiercely than anyone. Yet later, he amassed more wealth than anyone in the village.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Saleon killed him in the same way he'd treated the boy. Burned and pierced through the heart...

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: I had to evacuate everyone before the incident grew worse and more people were hurt. We couldn't repeat what happened ten years ago...

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Then Saleon caught another person. That one had tormented him alongside the dead man...

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Just then, Zephyros returned from the forest and rescued the person Saleon had seized.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: As Zephyros told me to take that person away, a little child with a devil's tail and a woman holding a pendant appeared.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The woman with the pendant is a witch. From another world...

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: I see. The moment that witch raised her hand and released a strange power from the pendant...

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: I was back at home. As though nothing had happened, with no memory of the incident...

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Not only the villagers, but even the guests who had stayed here briefly could no longer remember it.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: When my memories returned, I realized it. Even the existence of the two people Saleon had killed and tried to kill had vanished from everyone's memories...

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Along with their memories of seeing Zephyros...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The witch Morgana erased my and Chloris's memories of meeting a little girl named Mordred too. And...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I briefly tell Lif about meeting Morgana and Merlin in the forest, leaving out Hilda.)

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: This witch Morgana's abilities go beyond imagination. So she really is from another world...

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Sigh...

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: I summoned them urgently, to stop the witch and Saleon...

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: The Immortal Priesthood are monks who believe in the power and will of darkness. They have pursued witches for a long time, believing the witches defy the truth.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: There are stories that they're connected to the Magic Bureau, but now is not the time to question that.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Director Lif, Chloris said groups like that don't act easily...

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: I can tell you're someone remarkable, Director. But to mobilize a priesthood...

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: That isn't what's important now... No, I'll explain. This is the hero's authority.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Since ancient times, Lifthrasir's chief has been entrusted with the hero's authority. We may make any request of any group belonging to any religious order, including the elven order of Hodmis.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Provided the order finds the request reasonable, it is usually handled immediately. This is my first time making such a request, so it feels a little strange.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Is it simply an order accepting a request from a village chief who holds the hero's authority? I feel there's more to it...)

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: I've left it to priests from Dokkalf, so it should be all right. I also asked them to ensure Zephyros's safety...

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Still, I'm keeping watch, just in case. Oh, right...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: There is a small problem. Dokkalf priests tend to be hostile toward non-elves. Please be careful if you meet them.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: ...And %s... They didn't seem particularly fond of you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: They seem to dislike things getting complicated. I'm used to being disliked, but it still stings a little. Ahaha...

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Saleon... No, the boy who is now Merlin came here for revenge.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: And the witch will use him. She must be after something important to us.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: The hero's power...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But the hero died long ago.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Some of the hero's power remains in Lifthrasir.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: His power is divided between Twilight Cathedral and the Song of the Vanished Star.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The Song of the Vanished Star?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: ...A place where his remaining power was buried to keep demons from taking it.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: From the outside, it looks like a giant star-shaped ornament honoring the legendary hero. But there's a special way to enter it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah... When Merlin said his preparations were complete, he mentioned there was still time before the song of the star began.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: He learned how to enter the Song of the Star from my memories...

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: It will open soon. We must hurry... We have to protect his power.
(As Lif tries to rush off in a panic, Chloris stops her.)

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Director Lif, no.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Stay with the villagers, Director. Chloris and I will go there.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Do as %s says. In your current state, you won't be able to do anything.
(Lif nods as though making up her mind, then takes Chloris's and %s's hands.)

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Merlin has gone inside... But he won't easily find where the hero's power lies.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Now both of you can enter. I've made it possible for you to reach it before Merlin...

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Please don't ask anything. Stop him inside. While he's there, neither he nor the witch will be able to harm Lifthrasir...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right...

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: I'm sorry to entrust our village's troubles to you...

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: It's all right. We'll be back soon.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Chloris, is the place marked on the map?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: We'll be there quickly if we take this path.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. Let's go.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I'll need to prepare properly to face Merlin and his dream-demon power...)

steps.name: A Song That Never Faded
steps.objective: Defeat [Merlin] in 「Song of the Vanished Star」, then report to [Chloris] 「Outside Twilight Cathedral」.

lines.text: (At a quiet dead end in Crystal Moon Forest, deserted now, a huge star-shaped structure stands atop a small stone stairway.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This must be the place Director Lif described.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: I can feel tremendous magic within it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: One moment.
(The adventurer reaches between the parts of the structure, and a thin golden barrier stretched before them glimmers.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It looks like we can go inside.
So it was true. The stories about people entering this...
(A female elf peeks out from behind the star-shaped structure.)

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Who are you?
Clara...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you from the village?

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: I'm from Lifthrasir, but I don't live here now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why are you out here alone? Director Lif told everyone in the forest to return...

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: I couldn't find inspiration, so I kept walking and ended up here. The Song of the Vanished Star...

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: I love how it compares the hero to a star, and describes his passing as a song that vanished...

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: When I'm concentrating, I barely hear Chief Lif's voice... She's going to lecture me again...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Inspiration?

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: I write about all sorts of things... I'll head back soon.

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: But who are you two...? Everyone else has left, and here you are talking about going inside. I can tell Chief Lif sent you, but...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Chloris, what should we do? I think we should explain to Clara...

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Let's keep it brief.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Clara, I'm a mage named Chloris.

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: Ah... I think I've heard your name. I've read your book too.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: A spellbook?

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: No, not that. In the romance section of Belpa Library...

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: It was so much fun. What was the title again...? Hmm.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Aaaaah! Don't think about it, Clara.
(Flustered, Chloris holds out her hands and waves them.)

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: That isn't important right now.

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: All right... Then tell me what's important...

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: I don't know how much you remember, but someone who left the village ten years ago has returned...

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: Ah, ten years ago...
(Clara nods as though she understands.)

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: No wonder he looked familiar... He passed me and said, 'Thank you for back then.' I was wondering who he was...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You remember?

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: Remember? Ah, yes... It wasn't a pleasant affair... What happened? His name was... It was...

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: As I thought...

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: So that's what you meant by not remembering. All right, I'll go back.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's dangerous to go alone. Will you be all right?
(Before %s finishes asking, Lif's voice rings through Crystal Moon Forest once more.)

lines.speaker: 리프의 목소리
lines.text: 「Clara, wait right there!! Lunton is coming!」

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: I'd be fine on my own... But if Lunton is coming, it'll be all right.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Then stay here and make sure you go back with him.

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: All right...

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: %s, shall we go in now?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. I'm ready.
(As the adventurer and Chloris slowly step between the parts of the enormous star, the golden barrier glimmers again.)
(Soon the two are enveloped by the golden veil and gradually disappear.)

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: So it really exists... The mysterious space the legendary hero once entered...
(When the dazzling, many-colored lights finally fade, the space that had been impossible to see becomes clear.)
(Beneath a moon that seems to burn like a ring, fragments shaped like stars and moons lie scattered on the ground.)

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: The Song of the Vanished Star...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It feels like every beautiful form of the stars and moon that people know is here...

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: It does... Wait, %s. Over there...
(A man resembling a black wolf stands on the small hill Chloris points toward.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Saleon...
(Merlin leaps down and lands directly in front of Chloris and %s.)

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: It's been a long time since I heard that name. I abandoned it long ago.

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: Chief Lif must have told you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why were you waiting?

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: I came to tell you that you are not the targets of my revenge.

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: Those unconnected to Lifthrasir should go back. Nothing need happen to you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (In Orcarium, El-Larsa also told me to go back as though nothing had happened...)

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: I promise you...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You expect us to trust someone who has killed people?

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: Whether you believe me is your choice.

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: And they were people who would have to die by my hand someday.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: I'm sorry for what happened to you. But that doesn't justify killing people...

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: Taking a life with my own hands brings me no pleasure. But I... have no other choice.

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: Caught between two worlds, my very existence was denied, and my family died before my eyes. You expect me to stand by after that?

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: My memories have been filled with rejection, my time with suffering... And nothing could compensate me for it.

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: Even death needs an ending one can accept... I was not prepared for that...
(At that moment, Merlin points his pistol at Chloris.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Merlin!!
Bang! Bang! Bang!
(The startled adventurer rushes toward Merlin, but flames have already burst from the cold muzzle with deafening reports.)
(The bullets are stopped before they reach Chloris and fall to the ground.)

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: I nearly died for real...
(The enormous plant stems and leaves in front of Chloris scatter and disappear.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Chloris, are you all right?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: The spell I prepared earlier saved me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Whew... Thank goodness. But even so, I don't think I can forgive this.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Merlin!!
(With a loud cry, %s strikes powerfully at Merlin. But the instant %s's attack meets his shield, it rebounds harmlessly.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh...

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: I'd like to indulge you, but not now...

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: %s!! Are you all right?
(As a startled Chloris approaches %s, Merlin turns and leaps back onto the hill.)

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: Morgana told me you are someone a god cherishes... I had something I wanted to ask, but it would be pointless anyway.

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: The gods of Etoile ceased to be gods the moment they fled...

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: Sigh. I must finish first so Morgana can do her part.

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: It has not happened yet. But if you wish to stop it, you must reach the end of the Song of the Star before I do.
(With those words, Merlin descends the hill and runs off. %s and their companion hurry after him, but he is already out of sight.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: We lost him...

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: %s, shall we take a different direction from Merlin?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Pardon?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: He said we'd have to arrive before him because he doesn't know the way. Neither do we, so we may as well try another direction.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This must be the first time here for all of us. That makes sense.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: I'll follow the magic flowing through this place. Stay with me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. Let's hurry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Something about Merlin's words bothers me. Something that hasn't happened yet...)
(After running for some time along hills strewn with glowing star and moon fragments, we see a structure in the distance that seems out of place.)

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: That's...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A coffin...
(Roots and stems of star trees surround a white stone coffin. With the shining star fragments around it, the place feels deeply sacred.)

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: I sense a powerful force there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Could that be the power Director Lif mentioned?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Let's go and check...
(As I approach the stone coffin with Chloris, we meet Merlin's gaze. He has been sitting against it.)

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: You're a little late.
(Merlin rises and watches %s and their companion step back.)

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: Having that woman lead you here was a good choice. The power flowing through the Song of the Vanished Star is only...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait. What do you mean? If you're going to say something, finish it.

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: There's no point in a human hearing it...

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Merlin...

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: Let's make a bargain.

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: First, answer my question. Then defeat me. If you do, I'll give you the answers you want.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: That's a lot of conditions.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: And whichever we choose, Chloris, the outcome is the same for us.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Merlin...

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: Do you believe Lifthrasir's hypocritical elves have any worth?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: What sort of absurd question is that...?

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: I'll ask again. Do you believe Lifthrasir is worth it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who gets to decide its worth?

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: So that is your answer. Even though they are not worth your protection...
(Merlin quietly closes his eyes and toys with his pistol.)

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: Morgana... The day has come for me to complete my revenge on Lifthrasir, and for you to return to Azrael.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Chloris...

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: All right...
(As the two step back to prepare for what is coming, Merlin opens his eyes. Black wings, invisible moments before, grow from his back.)

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: I will erase you forever from Etoile and its people's memories... Fools who will share Lifthrasir's fate.
(Having exhausted her magic defending against Merlin's attacks from afar, Chloris loses consciousness and collapses.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Chloris!!
Click.
(A cold, hard touch of metal presses against %s's head.)

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: Any last words?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Stop...

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: Do you think I can stop? If I could, I would have stopped long ago.

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: Instead, beg for your life like the other hypocrites facing death. That would be a better approach.

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: Call the name of the god you cherish. Blame her and curse her. Then kneel and beg. Beg me to spare you!
(Merlin's previously unreadable expression gives way to heated words.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't want to call Iris that way...

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: You don't seek salvation...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: At the very least, my future isn't ending here and now.

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: You've already been saved. You fool, you don't even recognize salvation for what it is... Hahahaha...
(Merlin covers the burned part of his face with a hand and laughs wildly.)

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: So many lives begged the gods for salvation in the face of misery. Even as they died, they cried out the gods' names and pleaded again and again.

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: The greater the hypocrite, the more gods' names they shouted. 'Please spare me!' They clung to me, promising money and offerings!

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: Those I judged with my own hands, and those who died unjustly, were all equal before the gods. They all died.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Even so...

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: Silence!

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: You seem to think you're entitled to lecture me. Arrogant human... Then what is that power you possess?

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: Even if you call it a god's blessing, your present power must have been bought with someone's death.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Th-that's...

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: So what Morgana told me was true. A vile hypocrite...

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: Remember this well, %s... How empty and accursed your words are...
(As Merlin tightens his finger on the pistol, someone suddenly pops up behind him.)

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: Don't interfere, Mordred!

lines.speaker: 모드레드
lines.text: Hurry up, then let's play!
(Mordred thrusts her face forward, demanding to play, and throws Merlin off balance.)

lines.speaker: 모드레드
lines.text: Merlin, Merlin! Can I do it? Morgan said this would be fun.

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: Morgana did?

lines.speaker: 모드레드
lines.text: Okay!
(Mordred nods, then slips past Merlin with a bright smile.)
Slash!
(With a sharp bursting sound, black splashes fill %s's vision.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wh-what?! This is blood...

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: Mordred... Why did you...? Gah...
(Coughing up blood, Merlin barely holds himself upright. He looks ready to collapse at any moment.)

lines.speaker: 모드레드
lines.text: Sorry, Merlin. Morgan said she needed something. And that something is... demon blood hungry for anger and revenge!
(Mordred scratches her head, seemingly unsure what her own words mean. Then she opens a potion bottle she has somehow brought over and peers inside.)

lines.speaker: 모드레드
lines.text: Hmm. Good blood! She said it would be good if Merlin's blood went in here!
(Black blood drips from the tip of Mordred's spear, filling the potion bottle.)

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: ...So that's it...

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: All she needed was my blood... Gah...
(Merlin sinks to the ground with an empty expression.)

lines.speaker: 모드레드
lines.text: Hmm... Not quite enough. Morgan, can I take Lock's blood too?
(Mordred looks at %s's face and asks someone a question. Morgana's voice answers as though she were right beside them.)

lines.speaker: 모르가나의 목소리
lines.text: We don't need any other blood, Mordred. And that person was a key, not a lock. In any case, bring Merlin's blood back.

lines.speaker: 모드레드
lines.text: Oh, right! You said key! Hehe. But Lock is cuter! You're Lock-Key! I'm going to Morgan now! We'll play together later, okay?!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I can't lower my guard yet. Chloris is still...)
(Mordred waves goodbye. A black shadow rises behind her, wraps around her, and carries her away.)

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: Morgana!!

lines.speaker: 모르가나의 목소리
lines.text: Why, Merlin? I only did what you wished. I said I would help with your revenge.
(With each word from Morgana, the black shadow swells and contracts.)

lines.speaker: 모르가나의 목소리
lines.text: Your blood will fulfill both my wish and yours. Trust me. Your revenge will soon be complete. Trust me...

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: And how much did you trust me?

lines.speaker: 모르가나의 목소리
lines.text: I covered your memories of anxiety with trust and even gave you the power Arthur left behind. Apparently, it wasn't enough.

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: Wait... What am I now...? My memories...?

lines.speaker: 모르가나의 목소리
lines.text: You don't need to remember, Merlin. And now I'll take it back. I have no further need of you...
(Morgana's voice fades, and Merlin stops moving. Soon the Song of the Star fills with his screams.)

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: Ugh, ngh... AAAAAAGH!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Merlin? W-wait. This is...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The terror and dread I felt once before... This is...)
(As Merlin's pain grows, black blood continues pouring from the wound Mordred inflicted.)
(The blood on the ground slowly begins erasing the light from the glittering space.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Th-this is... B-Binding... Different from back then...

lines.speaker: 모르가나의 목소리
lines.text: %s, whatever you say now, you cannot stop me. My preparations are complete. I will return. His time will send me there more quickly.

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: I wanted revenge by my own hands... This wasn't... the ending I wanted...
(No more words come from Merlin. He does not move.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Merlin...?

lines.speaker: 모르가나의 목소리
lines.text: Just as Arthur intended, every life in Lifthrasir will vanish, and all the power within the cathedral will disappear.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Silence, witch! How dare you try to ruin this place! You will not have your way!
(At that moment, Lif appears in front of %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Director Lif?

lines.speaker: 모르가나의 목소리
lines.text: The hero's coffin has been tainted with demon blood. That power will never return...
(Lif gives a slight wink, and the black liquid around the coffin vanishes without a trace.)

lines.speaker: 모르가나의 목소리
lines.text: Interesting.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Hehe. This much is nothing.

lines.speaker: 모르가나의 목소리
lines.text: What an interesting elf. There's no power left here anyway, so I'll withdraw. You, too, will vanish tonight.
(Morgana finishes speaking and falls silent. The black shadow filling part of the space disappears as well.)

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Whew... A moment to breathe. Come to your senses, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What? Oh, yes...

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: I'll take care of Merlin. Leave here with Headmistress Chloris and go to the cathedral.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The cathedral...

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: The Immortal Priesthood has gone there. They must have sensed the witch's power.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: We need your help. Please.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: And Goddess, guide this unworthy elf... I will strive never to repeat my mistakes...
(As Lif speaks softly, the star-shaped structures within the Song of the Star begin shining brightly. One by one, they erase everything around them.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Director!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Director!!

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: The director is all right.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Director!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh?
(The surroundings are filled with beautiful, brilliant light, just as at the beginning. Only then does the adventurer take stock of the situation and look at Chloris as though nothing is wrong.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you all right, Chloris?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: %s, you acted so naturally that you startled me.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Anyway, whatever the director did seems to have awakened and healed me...

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Look. I seem all right, don't I?
(Chloris raises one arm as though nothing has happened.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's a relief.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Let's hurry to the cathedral, as the director said. I'll explain everything on the way!

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: All right!

steps.name: Morgana the Witch
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Chloris] 「Outside Twilight Cathedral」.
2. Enter 「Twilight Cathedral」 and defeat [Morgana] to obtain the <Pendant of Loss>. Then turn in the quest to [Chloris] 「Outside Twilight Cathedral」.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: ...So that's what happened.
(When Chloris learns what took place while she was unconscious, her expression saddens.)

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: I don't know what to say... Sigh...

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: I can feel Zephyros's magic inside.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If I were to guess from what Morgana said...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm... I'm not certain, though...

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: It's all right. Tell me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Weiss's power shook the place where the spirit of time lives. A rift formed, and the flow of time from within spilled out and affected the Windy Seed...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then that Windy Seed transformed both of you.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Some of its effects remain in me. Zephyros is probably the same. Unlike me, he still holds part of the power of time...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah! Morgana said his time would send her back more quickly.
(At %s's words, Chloris turns pale.)

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Morgana will return faster using Zephyros's time... Zephy, no...

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: She's planning to use him as a catalyst. He mustn't lose all his magic in the process.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Zephy... Zephy...
(As Chloris hurries toward the cathedral entrance, a soft, warm wind blows from inside and pushes her back out.)

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Zephyros, don't do this... Please...
(Chloris tries to enter again, but the same thing happens. The wind keeps blowing, preventing her from going inside.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Chloris.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Please wait here.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: But...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll stop Morgana and bring Zephyros out with me. Wait for us.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But just in case, if a long time passes and I don't come back...

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Don't say that, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right, I won't. Please trust me and wait.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Yes... I'll try.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I'll be back.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Still... How am I going to find them in a cathedral this big? I'd better go in first.)
(Inside the cathedral, enormous, majestic structures fill my view.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Incredible... Who would think to build something like this in a corner of the forest...? No, there's no time for that. I have to hurry.
(Mordred appears beside the running %s and begins running along with them.)

lines.speaker: 모드레드
lines.text: Lock-Key, where are you going?

lines.speaker: 모드레드
lines.text: Play with me! Let's play together~!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm not here to play.

lines.speaker: 모드레드
lines.text: Hmph. But you played with Arthur!
(At the name Arthur, %s's steps come to a halt.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Arthur... You mean Weiss, right?

lines.speaker: 모드레드
lines.text: Okay!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you know me because of Weiss? Since when?

lines.speaker: 모드레드
lines.text: Since when...? When was it...?

lines.speaker: 모드레드
lines.text: Oh! Since the moment Arthur came to Etoile!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So you've been with Weiss since then...

lines.speaker: 모드레드
lines.text: No, no. I was only born recently.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What are you?

lines.speaker: 모드레드
lines.text: Me? Will you play with me if I answer?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Y-yes...

lines.speaker: 모드레드
lines.text: Hehe. I'm a homunculus Morgana made using Arthur's memories, arranged into the components that make me.
(Even as %s takes a defensive stance, Mordred keeps demanding to play. Then Morgana's voice comes from somewhere.)

lines.speaker: 모르가나의 목소리
lines.text: Mordred, telling them that without permission... I told you not to, didn't I?

lines.speaker: 모드레드
lines.text: Arthur's friend means %s is my friend!

lines.speaker: 모르가나의 목소리
lines.text: It wasn't the intended result, but our Mordred has turned out a little like this...

lines.speaker: 모드레드
lines.text: Yep, that's just how I am, Lock-Key. Hehe.

lines.speaker: 모르가나의 목소리
lines.text: Mordred, no playing here. Play hide-and-seek inside instead.

lines.speaker: 모드레드
lines.text: Okay! Okay! But what's hide-and-seek?

lines.speaker: 모르가나의 목소리
lines.text: Ah... There must be no hide-and-seek in Arthur's memories... Then I'll teach you.

lines.speaker: 모르가나의 목소리
lines.text: Mordred will hide, and %s will look for you. The person who looks is called the seeker.

lines.speaker: 모르가나의 목소리
lines.text: Hide somewhere, Mordred, and when the seeker appears, kill them. Won't that be fun?

lines.speaker: 모드레드
lines.text: Yes, yes!! That sounds fun! Then Lock-Key is the seeker! I'll go hide!
(Cheering at the absurd rules of hide-and-seek, Mordred disappears into the distance.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This just got troublesome...

lines.speaker: 모르가나의 목소리
lines.text: %s, beings whose memories I've distorted will now rush toward you.

lines.speaker: 모르가나의 목소리
lines.text: Without even knowing that everything in Lifthrasir is going to disappear.

lines.speaker: 모르가나의 목소리
lines.text: I won't be waiting for you. I'll already be home before you arrive.
(Morgana's voice fades, and beings whose memories have been twisted by the witch's curse begin swarming in.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Morgana the witch...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You won't have your way.
(An out-of-place figure walks through a space so full of sacred light that it is dazzling.)
(Noticing Crystal Moon Forest through a window, she approaches it.)

lines.speaker: 모르가나
lines.text: Since coming to this world, I've never once thought it beautiful... But it is as beautiful as Azrael...

lines.speaker: 모르가나
lines.text: Poor Arthur disappeared without ever knowing this world's beauty. But... Hehe. I am happy.

lines.speaker: 모르가나
lines.text: ...There isn't much time left now...

lines.speaker: 모르가나
lines.text: I have the blood of one darker than pitch, and the power of time to serve as a catalyst. Now I only need to wait here, where sacred power remains...
(Then someone opens the chapel door and enters, casting a shadow over Morgana's face.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Morgana the witch. So you were waiting.

lines.speaker: 모르가나
lines.text: You've arrived sooner than I expected, %s...
(Morgana's expression twitches slightly at %s's suggestion that she was waiting.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who would have thought the cathedral's most important place was at the very top?

lines.speaker: 모르가나
lines.text: You've done well to reach me. Few children are as unwilling to give up as Mordred...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I've never played hide-and-seek like that before, but it wasn't so bad. Dodging her was a little difficult...

lines.speaker: 모르가나
lines.text: I created Mordred from Arthur's memories at the height of his strength. Comparatively, she should be stronger than the Requiem Arthur made.

lines.speaker: 모르가나
lines.text: It helped greatly when Arthur met a sinner from another timeline and interfered with another time. Chimera, was it...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You mean...

lines.speaker: 모르가나
lines.text: Hehe. You seem surprised. I thought you knew...

lines.speaker: 모르가나
lines.text: In accordance with merciful Merlin's wishes, I might offer you one last chance. What do you say?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: To beg for my life?

lines.speaker: 모르가나
lines.text: If that's how you understand it, go ahead.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...I don't trust you. You've already shown me everything I need to see...

lines.speaker: 모르가나
lines.text: You mean what I did to Merlin?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: 모르가나
lines.text: Merlin knew and accepted it. What's the problem? That's how the world works.

lines.speaker: 모르가나
lines.text: What you believe in can collapse in an instant, or rise again. The difference is paper-thin.

lines.speaker: 모르가나
lines.text: I don't think your coming all the way here is any different. You have your own purpose and wishes...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Morgana... You spout contradictions just like Weiss.

lines.speaker: 모르가나
lines.text: Do not insult Arthur.

lines.speaker: 모르가나
lines.text: If only you had become a key, Arthur and I would already be home...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Then again, if you thought clearly, you wouldn't have done any of this.

lines.speaker: 모르가나
lines.text: Sigh...

lines.speaker: 모르가나
lines.text: Waiting was becoming tedious... You've arrived at a good moment.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: As for me, I'll end everything connected to Weiss here, with you.

lines.speaker: 모르가나
lines.text: Right and wrong no longer matter.

lines.speaker: 모르가나
lines.text: I will make sure no one remembers you, foolish creature. Not a trace of you will remain in any time.

lines.speaker: 모르가나
lines.text: I didn't expect you to hold out this long. This will be the last...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I don't know whether there'll be an opening, but I have to watch for one...)

lines.speaker: 모르가나
lines.text: The last...
(As Morgana draws light from the pendant to shape into a weapon, the light slowly darkens and stops moving.)

lines.speaker: 모르가나
lines.text: What? What's happening...?

lines.speaker: 모르가나
lines.text: How... can this be...?
(Flustered, Morgana grips and shakes the pendant, but the blackened light does not return to normal.)

lines.speaker: 모르가나
lines.text: A dark power...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...I don't know what's happening, but let's end this.
(Morgana, who was unleashing attack after attack only moments ago, is powerless as %s takes her pendant.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This seems to be the tool that amplifies your abilities. I'll deal with it properly, as you said.

lines.speaker: 모르가나
lines.text: S-stop!!
(Despite Morgana's cry, %s's attack destroys the pendant on the ground. The black light around Morgana and the pendant grows faint.)
(Soon, the sound of breaking glass begins echoing repeatedly from within.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wh-what is that sound...?

lines.speaker: 모르가나
lines.text: Mordred!! Come here!! Come and kill your playmate!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Morgana, it's over. Give up...

lines.speaker: 모르가나
lines.text: Mordred will kill you...
(As Morgana struggles to contain her agitation, a great curtain of shadow rises behind her. A large staff wrapped in plant stems emerges and taps her shoulder.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (That staff...)

lines.speaker: 모르가나
lines.text: Mordred, hurry! Kill that... that woman!! Why aren't you answering?
I borrowed a little of your power. Your ability to manipulate memories and distort space...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A voice I've heard before... Could it be...?)
I sent her into the eternity of play she longs for.
Clunk.

lines.speaker: 모르가나
lines.text: Mord... red?
(A purple helmet falls in front of Morgana.)
A life made from someone's memories... Not truly reborn, but so very like...
(Seeing the helmet on the floor, Morgana sinks down and hugs it. A moment later, the woman holding the staff behind her slowly steps forward.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You're...
Is this your first time seeing me like this? You may not wish to exchange greetings, but I should introduce myself properly.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: I am Daphne.
(The moment the woman gives her name, the cathedral shakes violently again.)

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Long ago, I was the leader of the Kali people...

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Now I am merely one of the witches you know.
(As Daphne smiles, a barrier of unknown power rises around her. The adventurer, rushing toward her, is thrown back.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh...

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Hasty. Still, I'll give you credit for testing me.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: I have no business with you today.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...What are you going to do to Morgana?

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Give her the ending that awaits one fated to be a witch.
(The moment Daphne finishes speaking, everything in view distorts.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Wh-what is this...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh, ngh... I-I can't move.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Don't be afraid, %s. This isn't Binding.
(Daphne looks at Morgana, who is still sitting on the ground, clutching the helmet.)

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Morgana.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: You know, don't you?

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: How those who tamper with life end...

lines.speaker: 모르가나
lines.text: You... You too...

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Yes. I will meet my end someday as well. But not now. Now...

lines.speaker: 모르가나
lines.text: S-spare me. I... I didn't come here because I wanted to. I opened my eyes and found myself here. But... but!!

lines.speaker: 모르가나
lines.text: That damned black moon made me like this! It forced me to become a witch...

lines.speaker: 모르가나
lines.text: Though it was another time, I could have returned if Arthur had succeeded... I thought I'd succeed this time and go home...

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: So you tried to use the lives here. You gathered even the scraps of power left in Avalon. And you manipulated the memories of a young man living an ordinary life, awakening him as a high-ranking demon...

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Morgana... You have harmed many of my people. For every one of them, you will now...
(Daphne meets Morgana's gaze, then taps her shoulder with the staff.)

lines.speaker: 모르가나
lines.text: Daphne... Daphne!!
(Behind the barrier, Morgana's figure fractures into many pieces like a shattering mirror.)
Crack!
(The fragments surge upward with a thunderous crash, then fall to the floor.)

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: That should do...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Daphne, what have you just done...?

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: I am a witch, after all.
(Daphne looks at the glass fragments that were Morgana moments ago. As they crumble into dust, she smiles in satisfaction.)

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: ...I should test Morgana's power.
(Daphne dismisses the barrier and slowly approaches %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A-are you going to erase my memories?

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Think what you like. Though losing your memories would be cruel for you, I suppose.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Daphne, why are you doing this?

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Would you like an honest answer?
(At that moment, darkness begins closing in around Daphne and %s. It swallows everything, as though the cathedral with its radiant light had never existed.)

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: I am a witch whose fate compels her to act. And what I want is to change this star's fate before the night approaches...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Daphne!!
(With the witch's smile visible through the darkness, %s's memories end.)
(The world of darkness suddenly returns to brilliant light, and the standing adventurer sinks to the floor.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh... My head hurts...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I fought Morgana, took her pendant, and smashed it... And then Daphne...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Daphne?!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah! My memories... They haven't been erased.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Daphne said she would test Morgana's power...

lines.speaker: 도크알프 사제들
lines.text: Is this the person Director Lif mentioned...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Pardon?
(Priests of the Immortal Priesthood approach %s, seemingly from nowhere.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The priests who were attacking me a moment ago...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, yes. I'm looking for someone...

lines.speaker: 도크알프 사제들
lines.text: Ah, that mage...? He has already returned to the village with the director.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Already?

lines.speaker: 도크알프 사제들
lines.text: Already? You hadn't returned, so we've been searching for hours with the director. To think you were here...

lines.speaker: 도크알프 사제들
lines.text: The half-elf... I mean, your companion is waiting outside. Please go to her.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, all right...

lines.speaker: 도크알프 사제들
lines.text: And thank you for driving the thieves out of the cathedral. Thanks to you, we protected its treasures.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (So the people who tried to attack me were thieves...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Whew... The priests will take care of the cathedral. I should go to Chloris.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Still, the approaching night must mean Walpurgis Night...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Daphne...

steps.name: Echoes of Memory
steps.objective: Talk to [Chloris] 「Outside Twilight Cathedral」, then return to 「Lifthrasir」 and turn in the quest to [Lif].

lines.text: (Chloris sees %s emerge from the cathedral and runs over.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Chloris!

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: ...Are you all right? You're not hurt?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I'm fine. Please don't worry.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Were your memories erased? I was afraid you might not recognize me...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The teacher who destroyed the school...

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Thank goodness!! You remember properly. Wait, what did you say?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: I can't destroy the school, so shall I put some part of you out of commission instead?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll pass...

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: I'm joking! Just joking!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (She looked serious...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The people inside the cathedral seem to be back to normal...

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Yes. They recovered and split up to search for you on Director Lif's orders. Where have you been all this time, %s?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I tell Chloris what happened in the chapel on the cathedral's upper floor.)

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Daphne could already erase memories... But she defeated Morgana and inherited her ability?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: I can't believe it... How is that...?
So that's what happened.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (That man...)
(A man who looks identical to Notos, yet has a slightly different air, steps out from behind a tree.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Different-colored eyes, tightly set lips, horn-rimmed glasses... A little different, yet just the same. Definitely twins...

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Ah, Zephy... You're here. Are you all right?
I'm perfectly fine. %s, this is your first time seeing me like this, isn't it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lord Zephyros...

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Just call me Zephyros.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right, Zephyros. We've been looking for you.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: I had no idea so much time had passed. I followed the flow described in a spellbook into the forest, and that was the last I knew...

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: You're far too relaxed. I... We spent so long searching...

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: I wasn't relaxed. I simply knew nothing, Chloe. I'd like to call the whole thing absurd, but I've already lived through it.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Including, somehow, talking to a strange clock that kept hooting and a talking cat...

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: What are you talking about...?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Ugh... You'll think I'm mad, but it's true. Chloe...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Chloris, what Zephyros is saying is true.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: I knew you'd believe me, %s.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Really, %s?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There's a spirit world with a talking owl clock and a cat. 'I want to rest too, hoot.' 'I'm gonna have a nap.' That's how they talk.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: I... see...

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: ...Chloe, it's written all over your face.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Anyway, I'm sorry, Chloe and %s... I thought I could keep myself out of danger. I never imagined it would become such an incident...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where were you when you regained consciousness, Zephyros?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: ...In an attic on the cathedral's upper floor. There were traces of a barrier someone had placed there. So it was a witch's work...

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: %s, there's something I need to tell you. Not here. I'd like you to visit the academy's main building later...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Could you give me an idea what it's about?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: The Magic Bureau I've been investigating, what it has done, and what it plans to do...

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: I'll send you a message when the time comes...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Understood. I'll visit the Magic Academy then.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Oh, Director Lif said she has something to tell you when you return to the village...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The director...?)

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: We'll head straight back to the Magic Academy, %s...

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: We?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Yes, we. Why, Chloe?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: No, it's nothing...

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: I need your help, Chloe.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Y-yes...

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: See you later, %s. We have something to discuss here for a moment.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I'll go to the village and see the director. I'll see you both later...
(After the adventurer leaves for the village, the cathedral's priests also depart, taking the thieves disguised as detectives with them.)

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: It'll finally be a little quieter. Right?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Chloe...

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: First, I want to apologize. I'm going to tell you why you had no choice but to leave the Magic Bureau...
(Seated on a bench, Lif leans her head back and looks at the sky. Then she notices %s.)

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Ah, %s. You're here.
(Lif rises from the bench and takes %s's hand.)

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Thank you for protecting the village...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, what I did was...

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: No need to be so modest. Though I'd be grateful if you spent your retirement in our village someday...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You're joking, right?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Yes... My heart feels a little empty, so I keep making strange jokes. I'm sorry...

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: I knew you'd met two witches in the cathedral and were unharmed, but I sent the priests to look for you just in case.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you. Oh, but... You had something to say...? And how did you know I met two witches?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: I am this village's chief. I can faintly sense the memories rooted in Crystal Moon Forest.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Ever since the hero returned from his long journey, this place has been my very life.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I don't fully understand, but I feel I've just heard something extraordinary.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you for helping us in the Song of the Star. But what happened to Merlin...?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: The bright stars that have soaked into the ground of the Song of the Star are the memories of every life lived in Crystal Moon Forest. Our departed ancestors are there too.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: So I laid Merlin... no, Saleon, beside his mother. A little star and a great star...

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: I wanted to tell him Maria was there... But I was too late.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's all right. You did everything you could...

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: There's one more thing you should know. I'm not sure how to explain it... It's so strange.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: I remember everything. But the Lifthrasir residents and the others... All their memories connected to Saleon have been erased. Even those of the people he killed.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: And their fear of half-elves as ill omens, and the priests' hostility toward humans... As though none of it had ever existed...

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: The witch Daphne seems to have resolved it somehow, in her own way... But what should I call that...?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: It makes me a little sad that these memories remain only with certain people.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Daphne changed Lifthrasir's memories like this... What could she be thinking?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: I wonder...

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Sigh... I'll find my own way through this. We managed to get through the memories everyone regarded as a nightmare ten years ago.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: I no longer care whether this is right or wrong. People remember things however it suits them anyway.
(Lif smiles once more and stretches.)

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: I'll rest for just a few days. Without thinking about anything... Just a few days...

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Oh, I've only talked about myself. I haven't made you feel down, have I?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: My feelings are complicated. A little like yours, but a little different too...

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: You must have been through a great deal.
(Lif looks into %s's eyes and nods, as though sensing something.)

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: You seem to need rest too... Take some time off and stop worrying. We'll provide everything you need while you're here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Director.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The director said people remember things however it suits them... I think that was true of Morgana and Merlin too. And of me...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Could that be the answer? I still don't know...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Daphne appeared after staying out of sight for so long. Something must be happening...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I should rest a little, then visit Iris. They said she was all right, so I'm sure she is. But still...)
